verdict.rationale: Runpod documents SSH access to Pods with full shell capabilities, and it supports custom containers from any compatible registry, which gives developers substantial control over their environment. However, nothing documents using your own SSH keys or root privileges. Community users describe the execution environment as "very locked down," with SSH sometimes the only workable access path, which limits full environment control (containerized isolation). Missing for 10: documented bring-your-own SSH key setup, explicit root/sudo access, and independent hands-on confirmation of unrestricted environment control.
